```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  split
  · rw [Set.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨y, ⟨z, h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
    rw [h3]
    exact hf y
  · rw [Set.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨y, h1, h2⟩
    rcases h1 with ⟨z, h3, h4⟩
    rw [h4]
    exact hf z
```
